correctness.rationale: For every p,q>=2 and every admissible normalized inverse Gram, invertible congruence gives an exact diagonal-majorant SDP. Explicit positive-semidefinite sum-of-squares decompositions certify its primal feasible matrix in both regimes. A rank-one or rank-two correlation Gram matrix supplies a matching dual value with exact complementarity. PSD and diagonal-one force all alternative optimal diagonals to coincide. The packaged checker passed 450 rational parameter configurations including boundary cases, 20 random/perturbed model comparisons and 3 normalized-row examples. Finite checks do not replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The natural structured inverse Gram models both positive cross-cluster interactions and one antagonistic within-cluster interaction. The result replaces generic SDP solving with a full two-branch closed form, a sharp dimension-dependent screening threshold, a dual rank transition and uniqueness without symmetry restrictions, useful for understanding when common row-selection rules cease to be optimal.
